_comment: The journey. Chapters run in order; a run walks them one at a time and each has its own deadline.

chapters.name: The Waking Room
chapters.blurb: You wake up. The ceiling is familiar in a way you can't place.
chapters.scene: A single bed, a cold floor, and a door that is further away than it looks.

chapters.name: The House
chapters.blurb: Downstairs. The kettle is still warm, which is strange, because you have not been up yet.

chapters.name: The Town
chapters.blurb: Someone in the square greets you before you speak. You have not met them yet.
chapters.scene: Market stalls, a shopkeeper with a good memory, and Spite, waiting.

chapters.name: The Tall Grass
chapters.blurb: The path out of town gives up halfway and becomes grass taller than you are.
chapters.scene: Something moves alongside you the whole way and never shows itself.

chapters.name: The Long Road
chapters.blurb: There is nowhere to stay tonight, so how you sleep becomes the terrain.
chapters.scene: A roadside, a cold sky, and the mountain no closer than yesterday.

chapters.name: The Foothills
chapters.blurb: The ground tilts. From here the light on the mountain is clearly a window.
chapters.scene: Switchbacks, thin air, and someone else's old campsites.

chapters.name: The Observatory
chapters.blurb: A building full of instruments pointed not at the sky but at the town below.
chapters.scene: Notes in handwriting you recognise because it is yours.

chapters.name: The Summit
chapters.blurb: The light is a room, and the room has someone in it.
chapters.scene: The end of the loop, or the reason for it.
